title: Beowulf: Prologue (Lines 1–11)
author: Anonymous (Nowell Codex)
source: London, British Library, Cotton MS Vitellius A. xv, ff. 129r–198v

sentences.translation: Listen! We have heard of the glory of the Spear-Danes, of the kings of the people in days of old, how those noble ones performed deeds of courage.
